title: Sash
summary: SASH, noun 1. A belt worn for ornament. Sashes are worn by military officers as badges of distinction, round the waist or over the shoulders. They are usually of silk, variously made and ornamented. 2

inlines.v: SASH, noun 1. A belt worn for ornament. Sashes are worn by military officers as badges of distinction, round the waist or over the shoulders. They are usually of silk, variously made and ornamented. 2. The frame of a window in which the lights or panes of glass are set. She ventures now to lift the sash
